name: U.S. Census Annual Survey of Manufactures
known_limitations: Survey estimates are aggregate, subject to sampling and nonsampling error, industry classification, suppression, and revision; they do not establish a named plant's performance.
automation_notes: Preserve survey year, NAICS code, geography, estimate, unit, revision status, and reliability flags.
notes: Use for national and subnational manufacturing structure, not project-level delivery.
